accepted_claims: The public SDK and its conformance kit compile and pass PHPStan level 8 at the exact tested revision.
The fake and independently named Composer fixture adapters pass the same 14 public cases.
The normalized CallSession DTO rejects raw provider identifiers and reversed timestamps without introducing persistence.
Adapter registration and conformance require no private Larena package or commercial entitlement.
Denied, duplicate, unsupported and uncertain command paths fail closed before false success.
Receipts are deterministic and redact raw secret and provider-payload diagnostics.
notes: The third-party adapter is an independently packaged fixture maintained in the same local repository, not an independently reviewed vendor release.
Application installation, workspace composition, Asterisk and PBX behavior are outside G4.2.
blockers: An independent reviewer has not accepted the package or fixture receipt.
The package is not yet composed into larena-workspace or the root Larena application.
Asterisk, remote connector, media, CRM and AI voice runtime remain unimplemented and unauthorized.
